senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; שפר, cmp. שׁוּפְרָא)a goodly piece (cmp. דָּשְׁנָא), a certain quantity of meat, eshpar.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 36b:15">Pes. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ אחד וכ׳</he> an eshpar is one sixth of a bullock (as if composed of <cite ref="U02056"><he>שש</he></cite> and <cite ref="Q01526"><he>פר</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="A02517"><he>אֶסְפָּר</he></cite>).
